description:
You release a burst of burning light that deals ::damage ::damage_type damage in a small circular area.
The flash forces each affected enemy to sidestep and converts the damage dealt into stacks for Burning Light Trigger(12 burn stamina, burning light).
The surge summons Astral Wisps that echo your magic, up to a maximum of twelve.
This spell ignores party members.
name: Summon Astral Wisp Swarm
